style_summary: Close wide-angle action photographs interlocked with enormous warm-cream condensed background type, cobalt environmental depth, tactile ground or water, and a compact rule-divided editorial information rail.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: Activity, connected equipment and environment
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: a compressed peak-impact athletic movement close to the lens
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: the sport implement or ground material driving the impact moment
environment_variables.LOCATION: a cobalt-toned field, ring, water or gravel environment with deep wide-angle recession
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: enormous warm-cream condensed type behind the figure, plus spray, turf or gravel debris
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: the side rail label and the footer line of the editorial information block
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: the thin dividing rules of the editorial information rail
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: sport-specific kit that separates cleanly from the cream type

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] A close low wide-angle photograph puts one relevant equipment part or limb near the lens and a large connected athlete behind it; visible ground/water and natural displaced particles establish force and depth, not a floating sky-only cutout.

[CORE] Enormous warm-cream ultra-condensed uppercase grotesk type acts as the background graphic plane, extending through much of the canvas and occluded by the photographed body/equipment. Show enough of each word to identify it; deliberate outer-edge bleed is possible but do not lose whole letters.

[CORE] Cool cobalt or cyan-blue environmental field contrasts with warm cream type, pale neutral/dark navy sportswear, and one restrained warm physical accent. Hard daylight and believable shaded undersides give the action weight.

[CORE] Compact cream editorial annotations, a large small-area issue number and thin rules make a restrained edge information system; keep it subordinate and integrated with the photo, never a large detached footer panel.
[FLEX] Let the activity decide the leading near object, motion axis, horizon and type line breaks; choose distinct arcs, thrusts or lateral sweeps rather than repeat the source bat swing.

[FLEX] Subject scale, camera roll, title placement and crop respond to the ratio. Sky gaps and ground detail support the action; avoid unused lower bands, giant isolated text columns or three flat horizontal tiers.
source_content_to_avoid: Original baseball hitter, bat/ball swing and uniform identity
Original FULL SWING wording and source motivational copy
Original 09 issue number and 2025 date lockup
Exact source stadium crop, logos, stars and information-panel positions

visual_deconstruction.observation: Bat thrusts toward lower-left lens, batter occupies center-right, dirt rises around near foot. Giant cream words extend behind body and through blue sky; a narrow upper-right annotation stack and compact ruled bottom rail provide editorial detail.
visual_deconstruction.transfer: Retain interlocked photo/megatype depth, material force and compact information rhythm. Change activity and viewpoint; do not reduce this to sky plus top heading or copy bat silhouette.

composition.portrait: A connected near-object-to-body trajectory spans the canvas; backdrop lettering fills around and behind it. Compact edge information shares the ground plane without creating an empty band.
composition.landscape: Expand the force trajectory across width with separately chosen title breaks and information placement; no portrait crop or split text/photo halves.

typography.headline: Warm cream extra-bold ultra-condensed upright uppercase, long vertical strokes, tight spacing, large enough to act as backdrop; whole-word legibility survives partial body overlap.
typography.information: Small condensed uppercase in compact groups, thin cream separators and one stronger issue number; short accurate copy.

color_palette.system: Cobalt/cyan environment, warm pale cream typography, white/navy sports materials, modest rust-orange or amber physical accents; no lime graphics.
color_palette.dominant_hex: Approximate dominant colors sampled from the style preview, most to least common: #2C5692, #F5EDD9, #5F82B0, #393C4A, #646C7D.

image_treatment.texture: Fine photographic grain, true textile/metal/ground detail and localized dust or spray from action. Faint cream ink patina allowed; no yellowed paper wash, heavy distress, oversharpening or fake grit over faces.
image_treatment.light: Hard natural daylight with real contrast, subtle near-lens motion softness and coherent contact shadows.

design_rules: Integrate megatype behind athlete instead of separating title and photo.
Keep equipment and anatomy physically connected under foreshortening.
Use real action-driven particles only where material is disturbed.
Keep edge information legible but subordinate to the main photographic mass.
Review thumbnail balance and useful negative space as well as text and anatomy.
do: Use each action to determine composition.
Preserve blue/cream contrast and material depth.
Adapt both ratios independently with compact information rails.
avoid: Baseball-swing tracing or generic sky-only sports portraits.
Detached text columns, empty lower-third sky and decorative fill.
Unreadable headline, invented brands, excessive copy or impossible equipment.
negative_prompt: No logos, watermark, celebrity likeness, baseball uniform, bat, original slogan, neon lime, starburst, decorative stars, detached limbs, extra fingers, disconnected equipment, illegible words, old-paper tint, giant footer box.
prompt_template: Create one full-bleed photographic editorial sports poster. {STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS} Scene: {SUBJECT}. Exact main words: "{MAIN_TEXT}". Exact side annotation: "{SIDE_TEXT}". Exact footer copy: "{FOOTER_TEXT}". Portrait art direction: {DIRECTION}. For landscape instead: {WIDE_DIRECTION}. Use short information copy only as specified, arranging footer items into compact rule-divided groups. Warm cream condensed type behind the large athlete and near equipment, cool blue environmental depth, physically plausible action and hard daylight. Fine restrained photographic grain and true surface detail; dust/spray only where naturally motivated. Exclude {SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID}.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female field-hockey player in plain white/navy kit and orange gloves drives a small white ball on cobalt-blue outdoor turf. Low camera beside the curved hockey stick head; stick head in left foreground, continuous shaft connects to both hands, athlete in a deep planted lateral lunge behind it. Tiny turf granules at ball contact, dark-blue sky and distant low stadium structures.
values.FOOTER_TEXT: 12 | FIELD NOTES | STAY LOW | DRIVE THROUGH
values.DIRECTION: Huge near curved stick and white ball establish lower-left anchor, athlete extends diagonally across center-right with planted foot near bottom. LOW above DRIVE fills backdrop through blue sky and turf behind the figure; head and arms cross letter edges, both words readable. A narrow right-side annotation and compact lower-edge rail use remaining photo gaps, no empty lower third.
values.WIDE_DIRECTION: Near curved stick at lower-left, player lunges across width to right. Large LOW DRIVE backdrop arranged to fill sky and visible gaps around torso rather than a left text panel. Footer hugs the low turf edge.

values.SUBJECT: An adult male boxer in plain white athletic top, navy shorts and orange boxing gloves punches toward a very low ringside lens at an outdoor training ring. One foreshortened glove enormous near right foreground with continuous forearm to shoulder, other glove guards face, torso rotates; both legs planted on dark-blue canvas. Blue sky and minimal ring ropes recede, a few sweat droplets near shoulder, no opponent.
values.FOOTER_TEXT: 13 | RING NOTES | STAND FIRM | MOVE FIRST
values.DIRECTION: Near glove projects from center-right toward lens; grounded body runs diagonally into lower-left foot. Tall FIRST STRIKE cream text fills background behind shoulder and guard, breaks chosen for readable partial occlusion. Ropes and compact lower rail reinforce depth without boxing figure into panels.
values.WIDE_DIRECTION: Glove occupies near-left foreground and boxer torso center-right, feet and receding ring give grounded width. Backdrop words interlock across upper and middle gaps; side annotation opposite glove, thin-rule information rail compact at bottom.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female sprint kayaker in a low narrow navy kayak, ivory technical shirt and orange buoyancy vest, driving one black double-ended paddle through blue water. Very low camera alongside the near bow: large wet blade sweeps across lower-right foreground, one continuous shaft gripped naturally by both hands, paddler seated behind. Local water spray at blade contact; distant shoreline low and blue sky.
values.FOOTER_TEXT: 14 | WATER NOTES | FIND RHYTHM | HOLD COURSE
values.DIRECTION: Paddle forms a broad sweeping diagonal from near lower-right blade to hands upper-center-left; kayak bow grounds lower canvas. Giant CUT WATER backdrop behind paddler occupies upper and middle sky/water gaps with legible words. Information rail stays small over darker near water; retain visible connected paddle and both grips.
values.WIDE_DIRECTION: Kayak stretches across wide frame with near blade left and seated body right-middle; wet shaft creates force axis. CUT WATER forms tall cream backdrop across sky with limited head/shoulder overlap, compact annotation at one open edge and footer over dark water.

values.SUBJECT: An adult gravel cyclist in plain navy helmet, ivory jersey and orange gloves leans a drop-bar bicycle into a dusty banked turn. Low lens very close to near front tire, both hands visibly grip the continuous handlebar, feet stay on pedals and both wheels attach to a coherent diamond frame and fork. Tan grit kicked up by rear tire, deep cobalt sky, low rocky trail edge.
values.FOOTER_TEXT: 15 | TRAIL NOTES | READ THE LINE | KEEP ROLLING
values.DIRECTION: Near front wheel dominates lower-right, body leans diagonally toward upper-left; rear wheel recedes behind, both wheels identifiable. GRAVEL and RUSH are tall condensed backdrop words crossing behind rider and frame; no detached side column. Small rule-divided footer lies over dark dirt along bottom with minimal area.
values.WIDE_DIRECTION: Near front wheel occupies one lower corner, banked cyclist crosses center and rear wheel toward opposite side. Backdrop GRAVEL RUSH spans width with differing word scale, body occludes limited letters. Ground and dust remain near bottom, editorial rail follows available lower gap without detached panel.
